headlines.headline: SENSEX gains 600 pts, NIFTY50 recovers to trade higher after muted open; TCS, Infosys, other IT stocks power gains
headlines.summary: The Indian stock market indices were witnessing high volatility on Friday, November 6, amid the sharp rebound in crude oil prices and a global stock market crash due to sell-off in AI and tech stocks.

headlines.headline: Indian IT stocks shrug off Wall Street rout; NIFTY IT rises 2%, Infosys and TCS in the green
headlines.summary: Shares of major IT companies, including Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Wipro and HCLTech, were trading higher, defying concerns stemming from the sharp decline in US technology stocks.

headlines.headline: Stocks to watch, Nov 6: Coal India, Infosys, TCS, Titan, LIC, Bharti Airtel, Hindalco, Bosch, Hindustan Zinc
headlines.summary: Shares of Indian IT companies such as Infosys and TCS, among others, are likely to remain in focus on Friday, November 6, after a sharp sell-off on Wall Street overnight, led by technology and AI-linked stocks.

headlines.headline: Bharti Airtel Q2 FY27 results: Net profit rises 9% QoQ to ₹8,888 crore; ARPU stands at ₹271
headlines.summary: Bharti Airtel’s India mobile revenue surged 10.1% YoY, driven by strong customer additions and improved realisation.

headlines.headline: NIFTY50 gains 7.6%, SENSEX up 5,755 points after sixth consecutive days of rally; will NIFTY be able to hit 25,000?
headlines.summary: NIFTY50 and SENSEX have gained more than 7% in the last six trading sessions as of Thursday, November 5. Experts predict there is further upside potential for Indian equities amid consistent FII inflows.

headlines.headline: Diwali fireworks on D-Street: NIFTY BANK zooms 1,480 points; SBI, ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank in focus
headlines.summary: A sharp correction in crude oil prices, with the commodity slipping below the psychologically crucial $100-per-barrel mark, provided a major boost to investor sentiment.

headlines.headline: Crude oil crashes 8%: IndiGo, Asian Paints, HPCL, BPCL rally up to 6.7%; ONGC, Oil India slide
headlines.summary: Crude oil prices plunged more than 8% on Wednesday, November 4, settling at their lowest levels in over two months, as investors bet that the US midterm election outcome could accelerate efforts to end the US-Israeli war with Iran.

headlines.headline: Q2 Results, Nov 5: Bharti Airtel, LIC, Titan, Mahindra & Mahindra, ONGC, Britannia Industries, Bharat Forge, Glenmark Pharma, others to post earnings
headlines.summary: IT solutions provider Mphasis, pipe manufacturer Astral, healthcare enablement platform Inventurus Knowledge Solutions, tobacco manufacturer Godfrey Phillips India, general insurer Go Digit General Insurance, and housing finance company Aadhar Housing Finance, among others, will also release earnings on November 5.

headlines.headline: Airtel Q2 results: Revenue and net profit likely to see double-digit growth; key focus on ARPU and subscriber addition
headlines.summary: Bharti Airtel will announce its Q2FY27 results on Thursday, November 5. Experts expect strong double-digit growth in revenue and net profit, driven by subscriber additions, higher ARPU and growth in its Africa business.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, Nov 4: BEL surges 5%, Adani Ent, Titan rise 4%, TCS declines 2.5%; check list
headlines.summary: On November 4, the SENSEX advanced by 383.55 points or 0.50% to close at 77,301.40, while the NIFTY50 ended at its intraday high level of 23,960.60, up by 149.75 points or 0.63%.

headlines.headline: HDFC Bank share price surges over 7% in 5 sessions; new leadership and challenges ahead
headlines.summary: India's largest private sector lender HDFC Bank last Tuesday (October 27) said that Anup Bagchi had taken charge as its managing director and chief executive.

headlines.headline: NIFTY50, SENSEX recover after opening lower amid mixed global cues; SBI, ITC, Max Healthcare among top gainers
headlines.summary: After opening lower, both NIFTY50 and SENSEX recovered early market losses to trade higher on November 4, as investors analysed mixed global market cues and the weakness from Asian markets amid FII buying support.

headlines.headline: Market wrap, Nov 3: SENSEX jumps 1,225 pts, NIFTY50 ends at 23,810; NSE-listed firms add ₹5 lakh crore mcap
headlines.summary: BSE Limited took the lead among the gainers' pack, surging 5.03%, followed by Nestle India (4.47%), Tata Consumer Products (4.29%), Asian Paints (3.99%) and Bharti Airtel (3.77%).

headlines.headline: SENSEX rallies over 1,000 pts, NIFTY soars over 1% in noon deals; Marico, KRBL, Trident among buzzing stocks
headlines.summary: KRBL stock gained as much as 13.72% to hit an intraday high of ₹412.80 per equity share on the NSE on Tuesday, November 3, as its consolidated net profit rose 50.44% YoY to ₹258.93 crore in Q2 FY27.

headlines.headline: SBI net profit advances 14% to ₹23,038 crore, NII surges 15%
headlines.summary: State Bank of India's net interest income (NII) went up by 14.69% to ₹49,142.85 crore in Q2 FY27, compared to ₹42,847 crore in the same period of the previous fiscal year.
